verdict.rationale: First-party docs document self-hosting with a single Docker Compose command and a one-line install script, backed by a dedicated self-host guide. They explicitly target privacy-conscious organizations that need to self-host and own their data end to end. Community comments describe it as open source (AGPLv3) and easy to set up. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that clearly confirms self-hosted deployment, as the community setup comment does not specify self-hosted versus cloud.
